_note: Every value here is a TEAM ASSUMPTION for a prototype planning aid, not a NASA requirement or a certified limit. Change them here or per request from the UI.

max_slope_deg.label: Steepest grade a suited walker may take (uphill or downhill)

caution_slope_deg.label: Grade above which a caution flag is raised

flat_speed_kmh.label: Suited walking speed on flat, smooth ground

reserve_fraction.label: Fraction of the EVA budget held back as reserve

load_speed_penalty_per_10kg.label: Fractional speed loss per 10 kg carried
load_speed_penalty_per_10kg.basis: Team assumption (placeholder until a sourced model is chosen)

roughness_ref_m.label: Roughness at which walking speed halves

roughness_max_m.label: Roughness above which a cell is treated as impassable

roughness_caution_m.label: Roughness above which a caution flag is raised

round_trip.label: Plan must allow walking back to the start within the budget

speed_model.label: Speed vs grade: Tobler (1993) hiking function, rescaled so speed on flat ground = flat_speed_kmh
speed_model.basis: Tobler's function is an Earth hiking model; its use for suited Mars walking is an assumption
